liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Music never stopped refrains** (1 review): Track 10 is a slow, short bluesy take on the song [4]
- **Jam** (1 review): Track 11 is described as a kind of bossa nova jam [4]

## Setlist highlights

- **Stronger than dirt**: rare: 10 archived performances [10]
- **Mind left body thing**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **Music never stopped refrains**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **Music never stopped refrains**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **Tape in reverse**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **Music never stopped refrains**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **Music never stopped refrains**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [10]
- **Music never stopped jam**: rare: 3 archived performances [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1975-04-17.122863.flacf** (recommended): source not stated; 32 songs; 115 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: The uploader claims superb sound quality straight from their reel-to-reel masters [1]
- **gd75-04-17.sbd.backus.14291.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 29 songs; 77 min; rated 2/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Drums are barely audible, and the rhythm guitar sounds raw and unpolished [3]

## Around the show

- David Crosby rehearsed with the band without Jerry Garcia, focusing on rhythm takes [5]
- Bobby Weir appears to be teaching Crosby a couple of songs [5]
- Musically, this session seems to follow the March 17, 1975 session [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1975-04-17.122863.flacf**: source: Straight from my reel to reel masters [1]. Also: The recording originates from the uploader's reel-to-reel masters [1]
- **gd75-04-17.sbd.backus.14291.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: The soundboard was transferred to PCM, then processed and renamed to Etree standards [2]
